::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 22d 1893  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

Sir

I have no photograph at hand that I can spare but you can procure one in the February number of [‘Men and Women of the Time’](other_books/otherbook_613.qmd)or another from Elliot and Fay Baker Street.

I remain &c

C M Yonge
